lesson.title: I lost money to a UPI or online scam: what to do in India

claims.text: The national cyber-fraud reporting helpline number is 1930 and it operates in all States and Union Territories.
Complaints about cyber financial fraud can also be filed on cybercrime.gov.in, the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.
The RBI customer-liability rules of 6 July 2017 apply to unauthorised electronic banking transactions; a payment the customer authorised after being tricked may be assessed differently.
Under those rules a customer has zero liability where the fraud is due to contributory fraud or negligence by the bank, or a third-party breach reported within three working days.
Where a third-party breach is reported after three working days, customer liability is capped at Rs 5,000 for 4-5 working days, Rs 10,000 for 6 working days and Rs 25,000 for 7 working days.
Banks must effect shadow reversal within 10 working days and resolve the complaint within 90 days.

From 1 January 2027 amended RBI directions extend the framework to transactions the customer executed by granting approval under coercion or duress, and require faster complaint processing and compensation for small-value fraudulent transactions.
